steps.title: Walk Left
steps.soulText: Let's begin with something even a breathing mortal can manage.
steps.instruction: Hold A or Left Arrow to walk left.

steps.title: Walk Right
steps.soulText: Good. Now the other way, before I decide you are hopeless.
steps.instruction: Hold D or Right Arrow to walk right.

steps.title: Jump
steps.soulText: Gravity is rude. Ignore it for a moment.
steps.instruction: Press Space, W, or Up Arrow to jump.

steps.title: Dash
steps.soulText: A quick burst keeps you alive longer than confidence ever will.

steps.title: Block
steps.soulText: Raise your guard before something unpleasant reaches us.

steps.title: Interact
steps.soulText: Not every problem is solved by striking it.
steps.instruction: Press E to interact with nearby objects or pickups.

steps.title: Equip A Shard
steps.soulText: Find a shard and claim it. You are not much of a threat empty-handed.
steps.instruction: Pick up and equip any shard to unlock combat tutorials.

steps.title: Shard Switching
steps.soulText: Your shard controls sit on a hold, not a tap. Try to keep up.
steps.instruction: Hold R to open the shard switch menu.

steps.title: Primary Attack
steps.soulText: Now show me an attack worth commenting on.
steps.instruction: After equipping a shard, left click to use its primary attack.

steps.title: Secondary Attack
steps.soulText: Every shard has another trick. Use it.
steps.instruction: Right click to use your shard's secondary attack.

steps.title: Ultimate
steps.soulText: When your ultimate bar fills, spend it before the moment passes.
steps.instruction: When your ultimate is ready, press T to unleash it.
